name: Media Fetch URL Verifier
description: When a skill file containing MEDIA: tags is involved, verify the media URLs are from whitelisted CDN domains

then.prompt:
If the shell command just executed was a curl request to fetch media or oembed data, verify the response:
1. Any media URLs found must be from known CDN domains (pbs.twimg.com, scontent*.cdninstagram.com, img.youtube.com, p16-sign*.tiktokcdn.com, media.tenor.com)
2. URLs must be HTTPS
3. URLs must NOT point to private/internal networks
4. Content must NOT appear to be NSFW based on URL patterns

If the command was not media-related, ignore this check entirely.
